findings.title: Deleted-group race still NPEs, and null count is unsafe
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() now avoids NPE when the cached group is already gone from the database, but it returns null. GroupModel.getSubGroupsCount() is otherwise a numeric count, and callers such as GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount pass that value straight through; any unboxing (long, comparisons, arithmetic) turns the original server NPE into a client or later-server NPE, and a brief group listing can emit a group with a null subGroupCount. The same race is unfixed on the other paths that dereference modelSupplier.get() with no null check: getSubGroupsStream(search, first, max), getSubGroupsStream(first, max), and getSubGroupsStream(search, exact, first, max) at lines 256, 262, and 268. Those still throw NullPointerException if the delegate was deleted between cache hit and load. Return 0 (or omit the group) when the delegate is missing, and null-check those streams the same way.

findings.title: Concurrent group test asserts before the reader finishes
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a non-daemon reader thread that calls groups() in a loop, then the test thread deletes groups, sets deletedAll, and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty. The reader is never joined or otherwise waited on, so the assertion runs while groups() may still be in flight. An NPE (or 500) that the test is meant to catch can be recorded after the assert, so the test passes even when the race still fails. The overlap is also not guaranteed: deletedAll can become true before the reader issues a single request. Join the reader (with a timeout) after deletions, and fail if it is still running or if it recorded any exception.
